queries.name: Movies by Actor
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m1.name AS movie_name, m1.date FROM movies m1 JOIN casts c1 ON m1.id = c1.movie_id JOIN people p1 ON c1.person_id = p1.id JOIN jobs j1 ON c1.job_id = j1.id JOIN casts c2 ON m1.id = c2.movie_id JOIN people p2 ON c2.person_id = p2.id JOIN jobs j2 ON c2.job_id = j2.id WHERE p1.name = :actor_name AND j1.name ILIKE '%actor%' AND p2.name = :co_star_name AND j2.name ILIKE '%actor%' ORDER BY m1.date NULLS LAST;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m1.name AS movie_name, m1.date
FROM movies m1
JOIN casts c1 ON m1.id = c1.movie_id
JOIN people p1 ON c1.person_id = p1.id
JOIN jobs j1 ON c1.job_id = j1.id
JOIN casts c2 ON m1.id = c2.movie_id
JOIN people p2 ON c2.person_id = p2.id
JOIN jobs j2 ON c2.job_id = j2.id
WHERE p1.name = 'Tom Hanks' AND j1.name ILIKE '%actor%'
  AND p2.name = 'Meg Ryan' AND j2.name ILIKE '%actor%'
ORDER BY m1.date NULLS LAST;

queries.name: Movies by Actor
queries.sql: SELECT m.name AS movie_name, m.date AS release_date FROM movies m JOIN casts c ON m.id = c.movie_id JOIN jobs j ON c.job_id = j.id JOIN people p ON c.person_id = p.id WHERE p.name = :actor_name AND j.name IN (:job1, :job2) ORDER BY m.date DESC NULLS LAST;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT m.name AS movie_name, m.date AS release_date
FROM movies m
JOIN casts c ON m.id = c.movie_id
JOIN jobs j ON c.job_id = j.id
JOIN people p ON c.person_id = p.id
WHERE p.name = 'Jennifer Aniston' AND j.name IN ('Actor', 'Actress')
ORDER BY m.date DESC NULLS LAST;

queries.name: Movies by Actor
queries.sql: SELECT m.name AS movie_name, m.date AS release_date FROM movies m JOIN casts c ON m.id = c.movie_id JOIN people p ON c.person_id = p.id JOIN jobs j ON c.job_id = j.id WHERE p.name = :actor_name AND j.name = :job_name AND m.kind = :movie_kind ORDER BY m.date DESC NULLS LAST;
queries.original_sql:
SELECT m.name AS movie_name, m.date AS release_date
FROM movies m
JOIN casts c ON m.id = c.movie_id
JOIN people p ON c.person_id = p.id
JOIN jobs j ON c.job_id = j.id
WHERE p.name = 'Jennifer Aniston' AND j.name = 'Actor' AND m.kind = 'movie'
ORDER BY m.date DESC NULLS LAST;
